reply: With +25% jitter, the last retry can wait about 37 seconds. I suggest a new item that caps each delay at MaxDelay.

edits.summary: Add P6: Cap the jittered delay at MaxDelay
edits.reason: A cap keeps the longest wait at 30 seconds, even with jitter.

new_item.title: Cap the jittered delay at MaxDelay
new_item.intent: No retry waits longer than MaxDelay (30 seconds), even with jitter.

edits.summary: Add a test for a negative Retry-After value to P3
edits.reason: A negative number of seconds must be ignored, like a date in the past.
